description: Points de captages (Cantal) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. PLEASE NOTE: The use of this data is restricted to PRODIGE members for reasons of public safety. The collection point covers different installations allowing the water to be diverted and transported to the treatment unit or sometimes directly in the distribution network. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Capture points (Cantal)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RHONE ALPES, Captage. The listing shows 2013-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
